capabilities: Append keys to front matter automatically
Customize front matter content with custom actions
Trigger front matter updates via commands or shortcuts
Combine with Commander macros to run on save
extras: README is bilingual (Chinese and English); the save-on-modify and sorting features were removed in V2, with the FAQ explaining why the save hook caused infinite modification events.
problem: Obsidian doesn't automatically add or update front matter keys, so users must edit properties manually or on every save.

relations.evidence: It is recommended to use it in combination with Commander's macro commands + shortcut keys

summary: Automation tool that automatically appends or updates YAML front matter keys in Markdown notes, triggered by commands or shortcuts.
